01 / The game

Seven characters.
Every move matters.

A turn-based tactical card game on a 7 × 7 board. Lead a small cast of extraordinary characters, reshape the battlefield with relics and events, and make every action count.

Position

Outthink the board.

Seven roles, distinct abilities, and no throwaway pieces. Choose who advances, who protects, and who takes the risk.

Power

Change the rules of a fight.

Level up your characters. Bring relics into play. An event can turn a safe position into the most dangerous place on the board.

Purpose

Fight for more than ground.

Hunt the opposing Hero, defeat their army, or bring Spirit Embers to the center. Every path to victory creates a different threat.

Currently in developmentMeet the forces in the convergence ↓

02 / The lore

One sleeping mind.
Worlds at war.

In a Soviet closed city in the 1980s, a strange nuclear accident leaves Dr. Mikhail Orlov unconscious. Inside his sleeping mind, other realities begin to converge.

Wartime memories. Northern spirits. Atlantean knowledge that should have been lost beneath the sea. Are these dreams, transmissions, or real worlds pressing through one damaged human mind?

Nothing here belongs to only one age

Old loyalties meet unfamiliar worlds. Everyone caught in the convergence has something to protect, something to discover, and a reason to survive.

The first opposing forces

Two ways to survive the impossible.

Forbidden science / Fractured minds

The Closed City

Scientists, soldiers, and test subjects stand inside a breach they cannot contain. Leaks reshape the battlefield. Dream Link carries allies across it. Power comes with consequences.

What happens when the experiment starts dreaming back?

Buried knowledge / Living memory

The Flood Survivors

Atlantis did not end with the flood. Beneath the water, below the earth, and along the routes into Egypt, survivors preserved what the world forgot. Stone, memory, and hidden vaults are their inheritance.

A civilization can drown. Its memory can still fight.

03 / A tarot from the MythCards universe

Dreams of the North

A MythCards Tarot

A different way into the same universe. A 78-card tarot journey through the Closed City, a wartime army, and the remote Far North. Future deck sales will help bring the game to life.

Scientists become Magicians. Hidden knowledge takes the form of a High Priestess. The familiar Arcana reveal the people, relics, and forces within the convergence.

Can I order a deck yet?+

Not yet. We want to review the physical deck before taking orders. There are no purchases or paid preorders on this site.

Do I need to play the game to use the tarot deck?+

No. Dreams of the North follows the 78-card tarot structure and can be enjoyed independently. The MythCards story adds another layer to the imagery.

Can I play MythCards yet?+

The game is in active prototype development. There is no public game launch on this site yet. The screenshot above shows the development prototype, not a finished release.

When will the deck be available?+

A release date and price have not been announced. They will be shared here after the printed deck is ready for review.
